hook: Young India Police School gets *₹50 lakh* for labs, library
hook_b: Young India Police School gets *₹50 lakh* for labs, library
tldr: Optimus Group's D. Srinivas Reddy handed the cheque to DGP C.V. Anand at an open house in Mindspace.

beats.what: The money will go to classrooms, science and tech labs, a library, sports and digital learning.
beats.why: The DGP appealed to companies and philanthropists to help build the school's facilities.
beats.care: Families looking at schools: it admits children from police families and the public.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The Hindu: The DGP appealed to more industrial and commercial organisations to contribute.

cards.q: Should companies fund public schools' infrastructure?

qs: How does a school funded by donations decide what to build first?

facts.t: The school serves *2 groups*: police families' children and the general public.

watch: Whether other companies follow with donations.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Young India Police School in Hyderabad receives donation of ₹50 lakh

fact: Hyderabad's Young India Police School receives a *₹50 lakh* donation.
twist: The school is open to the general public, not just children of police families.
